page_title: AUX 3-1 MET | Auxerre v Metz 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a change. Mamoudou Cissokho (Auxerre) replaces Lassine Sinayoko.
90+4' That's the end of the game for Oussama El Azzouzi, who is replaced by Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

89' 3 - 1 Kevin Danois (Auxerre) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the left side of the net.
88' Brian Madjo (Metz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
87' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Kevin Danois (Auxerre) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
84' A substitution has been made. Boubacar Traore goes off and Brian Madjo (Metz) comes on.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Stephane Le Mignan prepares a substitution. Jessy Deminguet is replaced by Alpha Toure (Metz).
77' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sekou Mara leaves the pitch and Josue Casimir (Auxerre) comes on.
73' Here comes a substitution. Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) is brought on as a substitute for Fredrik Oppegard.
70' Gauthier Hein (Metz) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
68' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Malick Mbaye (Metz) replacing Cheikh Sabaly.
68' Today's match ends for Georgiy Tsitaishvili who will be replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
66' Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
65' Auxerre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' Auxerre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.

64' Jonathan Fischer pulls off a great save to deny Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Auxerre.
62' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) out-muscles his marker and gets the ball from the corner kick. He produces a shot, but it goes way wide of the left post. High, wide and not pretty at all.
62' The ball goes out of play and Auxerre have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Donovan Leon comes off the line to clear the ball away.
59' Great teamplay by Metz as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
58' Habib Diallo (Metz) commits a foul and Eric Wattellier immediately signals a free kick.
55' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Eric Wattellier saw the whole situation.
54' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
52' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
50' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
48' Auxerre fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
48' Habib Diallo (Metz) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
46' Stephane Le Mignan makes a switch. Habib Diallo is coming on in place of Joel Asoro (Metz) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Eric Wattellier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Jonathan Fischer anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
45+1' 2 - 1 Gauthier Hein (Metz) sends the ball into the net from a long-distance direct free kick. It goes exactly inside the right post. Sensational free kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Eric Wattellier shows a yellow card to Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
44' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Metz.
43' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) takes a long-range shot, but his attempt is not a big threat to the goalkeeper.
39' 2 - 0 Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
36' 1 - 0 Goal! Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jonathan Fischer into middle of the goal.
36' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) is going to take the penalty!
35' The Auxerre players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
34' There's a break in play and referee Eric Wattellier must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Auxerre using VAR. This could be interesting!
33' Sadibou Sane (Metz) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

33' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Auxerre force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
26' Eric Wattellier blows for a foul after Boubacar Traore (Metz) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
25' Neat passing move from Metz in order to create new attacking opportunities.
22' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
21' CHANCE! Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) connects with a cross but he cannot direct his shot on target.
19' Boubacar Traore (Metz) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
17' A cross into the box from Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) is cleared.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Auxerre.
14' Close! Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
13' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 31:69.
11' The Auxerre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
9' Oussama El Azzouzi (Auxerre) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.

7' Boubacar Traore (Metz) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
7' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Metz.
7' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Metz win a corner.
6' The Metz players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Metz.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Metz will have the kick-off.
Eric Wattellier is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
